headline: Base Fighting Intensifies Along the Central Front
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has grown still hotter, recording 12 strategic-base events in the latest two hours and 63 over the day. Its ledger now reads four Warden, two Colonial, and three neutral bases, marking continued flux rather than a settled line. Mooring County has likewise added six events in two hours and 34 across 24 hours; the balance there is now ten Warden to two Colonial bases, a change from the previous report. Callahan’s Passage remains active, with three fresh events and 19 over the day, though all ten bases presently stand Warden-held. Nevish Line has added three events in six hours and now shows six Warden and two Colonial bases. Older turbulence remains on the books at Kuura Strand and Fisherman’s Row, but neither has reported a fresh event in the latest six-hour window. Most other sectors show little or no base movement, leaving the principal near-term watch on the heavily contested central fronts.
